title: Canonical bounded site Hom-chain and right-object comparison
statement: Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring and $c$ a compactification of $f:X\to Y$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Write $F_e=Rf_!^e$ and $F_p=Rf_!^p$ for the ordinary-etale and pro-etale compact-support functors [def-amb-etale-compact-support] [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed] on ordinary constant-$A$ module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. Let $F_e\dashv H$ be an adjunction, and write $C_T\dashv U_T$ for derived site comparison [def-sf-comparison-derived-pullback]. Use $B:C_YF_e\cong F_pC_X$, the inverse of the ambient comparison of [def-sf-compact-support-site-comparison-construction]. For $J\in D^+(X_e,A)$, $L\in D(Y_p,A)$ and $z:F_pC_XJ\to L$, define the bounded site transpose by $C_X(\operatorname{adj}_H(\operatorname{adj}_{C_Y}(B_J;z)))$. Its target is $C_XHU_YL$. For $K\in D(Y_e,A)$ define $\rho_K=C_XH(\eta_K):C_XHK\to C_XHU_YC_YK$, where $\eta$ is the actual comparison-adjunction unit. These are formulas for functions and arrows; no invertibility or boundedness of $HK$ is part of this definition.
